name: Quadrant
author: Bernard Visagie
description: Unified system monitor for the Quattro bar: CPU, GPU, memory, network, and an optional disk segment, with a tabbed detail panel.

barWidget.description: CPU, GPU, memory, and network meters with a tabbed detail panel (Drives tab included; disk bar segment off by default)

schema.label: Bar segments
schema.description: Which metric segments appear in the bar slot. Any subset of: cpu, gpu, memory, disk, network. disk is off by default. Each panel tab has a Show in bar checkbox that updates this list. An empty list keeps a compact system-monitor icon. GPU and disk segments hide themselves when no supported device is detected.

schema.label: Process rows (1-10)
schema.description: How many top processes each panel tab lists.

schema.label: Bar refresh (ms)
schema.description: Cadence of the streaming sampler that feeds the bar segments and history graphs. 250-60000.

schema.label: Panel refresh (ms)
schema.description: Cadence of the on-demand samplers that run while the panel is open. 500-60000.

schema.label: Interface (auto or name)
schema.description: Interface whose rates the network segment and tab report. 'auto' picks the default route across IPv4 and IPv6 by lowest metric.

schema.label: GPU (auto or cardN)
schema.description: Which card the GPU segment and tab read. 'auto' prefers the boot display card, else card0.

schema.label: Disk (auto or name)
schema.description: Which whole block device the disk segment and Drives tab follow. 'auto' prefers the disk backing /, else the largest.

schema.label: Bar palette (theme or vivid)
schema.description: theme (default) paints bar meters with the live Omarchy accent, a foreground-derived track, and urgent at ≥90% load. vivid keeps the original per-resource Tokyo-night hues.

schema.label: Bar labels (glyph, letter, or none)
schema.description: How CPU, GPU, memory, and disk cells are labelled. glyph (default) uses Nerd Font icons; letter falls back to C/G/M/D; none shows only the percentage.
